title: The Tank III: The Hand
transcript:
Eight.
His chest is on fire. The grate is cold against his knee.
Raman's hand is locked round his wrist, and Raman is pulling, and the light is so far up.

Raman looks at him. He isn't scared any more. He's asking.

Parth twists his arm. Once. Twice.
Small fingers slide off his skin one at a time.

He kicks. He doesn't look down.
Air. Sun. The dog barking on the steps.

He waits for Raman to come up behind him and say again.
He waits a long time.
